zh.title: 手机端新增 Claude Code 与会话续接
items: 手机端现在可在 Codex、Kimi 与 Claude 之间切换，并新建或继续电脑端 Claude Code 会话。
Claude Code 的流式回复、工具审批、提问与子 Agent 状态通过端到端加密链路显示和操作。
会话选择会按设备与 Agent 恢复，刷新后继续停留在正确会话；默认 Agent 仍保持 Kimi。

en.title: Claude Code and session continuity on mobile
items: Mobile can now switch between Codex, Kimi, and Claude, then create or continue Claude Code sessions running on the paired computer.
Claude Code streaming responses, tool approvals, questions, and subagent status are available through the end-to-end encrypted link.
Session selection now restores per device and agent after refresh, while Kimi remains the default agent.
